topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture on cancer therapy and outlines its core learning objectives.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Their Limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the application, mechanisms, and therapeutic limitations of conventional cancer treatment modalities.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss strategies that target the intrinsic molecular vulnerabilities and checkpoint deficiencies of cancer cells.

topics.label: Targeting Oncogenes and Kinase Inhibitor Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the principles of targeting oncogene addiction with kinase inhibitors and the mechanisms underlying therapy resistance and drug addiction.

topics.label: Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how engineered monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates are used to target tumor cell-surface markers.

topics.label: Cancer Immunology and T-Cell-Directed Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the role of the immune system in cancer and the therapeutic approaches used to mobilize or engineer T cells against tumors.

topics.label: Therapeutic Progress, Persistent Challenges, and Future Perspectives
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize the broader clinical progress, persistent challenges, and future avenues in cancer therapy and patient care.
